summary: Restore the missing preterit-wa ending in mwaʕad-wa.
rationale: The supplied corpus at 52/34 reads mwaʕadwayle. The same passage is quoted in the wʕd entry, stem II Preterit-wa, as mwaʕád-way-le. The dgl quotation drops the ending -y-le; restoring it is more than a clitic-boundary normalization.

summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1b in Imperativ (Lahdo Traitor 1/67)

data.turoyo: Dʕar, mdagal u mede, d məllux, mdagele bag gazetat, bat talafəzyone.
data.translation: take it back and deny what you have said, deny it in the ne.., in the newspapers and on television.

rationale: New content-object denial subsense and new Imperativ box; one quotation illustrates both commands.

summary: New sense 1b: (mit direktem Sachobjekt) eine frühere Aussage oder Angelegenheit bestreiten, widerrufen

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: (mit direktem Sachobjekt) eine frühere Aussage oder Angelegenheit bestreiten, widerrufen

rationale: Commands mdagal u mede d məllux and mdagal i masale select the content being denied; this differs from lying absolutely or deceiving a person. Repeated in one interview, not independent speakers.

summary: New sense 1c: (mit ʕal) über jemanden lügen, jemanden verleumden

data.label: 1c
data.gloss: (mit ʕal) über jemanden lügen, jemanden verleumden

rationale: ʕal marks the person accused rather than the deceived addressee: PrS 84/76 explicitly links the accusation to having the speaker killed; PrS 60/104 supplies a parallel.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (JTM 1.3/2)

data.turoyo: Qəsəm mənayye kowən ḥawrone, u babo du kurrəko w di kaččəke, mi naʕmuṯayye kowən mdagle d ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Manchmal sind der Vater des Jungen und der Vater des Mädchens Freunde, und (die Kinder) sind einander seit ihrer Kindheit versprochen.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; plural with childhood-duration and reciprocal d-.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (JTM 5.2/1)

data.turoyo: heš an naʕimaṯṯe b gawe dann emoṯaṯṯe mdaglənne ʕam ḥḏoḏe, d howən muxalafa gdowən l ḥḏoḏe, yaʕni kačke ya kurrəko d awo, ya d awo kurrəko w d awo kačke, d ibinne l ḥḏoḏe, yaʕni kačke ya kurrəko dawo, ya d awo kurrəko w d awo kačke, d əbinne l ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Als ihre Kinder noch im Mutterleib waren, versprachen (die Väter) sie einander. Wenn sie von unterschiedlichem (Geschlecht) sein würden, sollten sie für einander bestimmt sein, d.h. ein Mädchen oder ein Junge von dem einen, oder von jenem ein Junge und von diesem ein Mädchen, die würden sie miteinander verheiraten.

rationale: Preterit sense 2 had three examples; reciprocal prenatal betrothal is self-contained.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit-wa (JTM 5.2/7)

data.turoyo: haṯe nuxraytux wa l babux, lu babo mdaglowale ʕam babux, babux mayəṯ, annaqqe uʕdo fayəšitu yatume lə kubalxu yo, qay lə kowət moro l nuxraytux?
data.translation: Das war deine Verlobte, ihr Vater hatte sie deinem Vater zugesagt, doch dein Vater ist gestorben, und nun seid ihr Waisen, und er gibt sie euch nicht. Warum kümmerst du dich nicht um deine Verlobte?

rationale: Thin Preterit-wa cell, with overt father agent and ʕam partner.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC NE Mem and Zin/35)

data.turoyo: ‘Ya, Mămoye Alá laḏiʕallux, mdageli’, ḥaša, ‘xili əḥre w ḥaṭyono. Šəbqono, kəbʕono duʕrat. Laḏiʕallux.’
data.translation: ‘Oh Mămo Ala, I did not recognize you, I misspoke’, excuse me, ‘I ate shit and sinned. I am sorry, I want you to return. I did not recognize you’.

rationale: Thin Preterit sense 1; retain edition 'misspoke' without establishing an accidental-speech sense.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part act. (MAC NE Mor Barsaumo/41)

data.turoyo: Əmmi, ‘Haaa, Barṣawmo mdaglono! Koyo u+maṭro dl Aloho mṭelelan? U+alohayḏux, koyo?’
data.translation: They say, ‘Aha! Barsawmo the deceiver! Where is the rain that God has brought us? Your God, where is he?’

rationale: Thin Part act. cell; accusation with an explicit named subject.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/20)

data.turoyo: ‘Liwoli, hăma mdagalto dḥayo.’
data.translation: ‘I have not given her up, but she is betrothed to someone’.
data.ref: MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/20

rationale: Thin Detransitive cell; contrasts completed giving and current betrothal.

evidence.cite: MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/20

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/21)

data.turoyo: W layban dlo+maḥunayna u+ḥrènostene dəmdaglínala.
data.translation: Save with our other brother we are unable to betrothe her.
data.ref: MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/21

rationale: Thin Infectum sense 2; pronominal theme after inability predicate.

evidence.cite: MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/21

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 7/19)

data.turoyo: Əmmo: “Qay mdagelox ʕal aḥuni?”
data.translation: Sie fragte: »Warum hast du meinen Bruder belogen, (du wollest mich heiraten)?«

rationale: Thin Preterit sense 1; clear ʕal deceived person.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 18/27)

data.turoyo: Omər: “Of, koṯe riḥe d əns harke gabəx.” Əmmo: “Ya ʕaft Ḥusayn, mahzamluxli mu aṯro dag gurǧ w mamṭeluxli larke, lu quṣrano bayn ab baḥare. Nošo laybe d oṯe l gabi.” Omər: “Mdageli.”
data.translation: »Es riecht hier bei dir nach Menschenfleisch«. »Aber, o Riese Ḥosein«, entgegnete sie, »du hast mich aus dem Lande der Gurdsch entführt und hier in dieses Schloss mitten im Wasser gebracht; wie sollte da Jemand zu mir gelangen?« »Ich habe mich getäuscht«, sagte jener.

rationale: Thin Preterit sense 1; preserves a complete retraction dialogue and its edition translation, without creating an error sense.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 33/61)

data.turoyo: Aṯən, mamṭalle, məblile li qalʕayḏe. Əmmi: “Koyo babayna?” Omər: “Dugle mdageli aʕlayxu.” Əmmi: “Gəzzano.” Mḥelelən, bu zor ksoyəm aʕmayye.
data.translation: Er aber nahm sie mit sich auf seine Burg. »Wo ist unser Vater?« fragten sie. »Ich habe euch belogen«, erwiderte er. »So gehen wir wieder weg«, sagten sie. Er aber schlug sie und zwang sie mit Gewalt zu seinem Willen.

rationale: Fills Preterit sense 1 to five, illustrating ʕal plural target and cognate dugle.

summary: example for sense 1c in Infectum (PrS 60/104)

data.turoyo: Əmmo: "Itaw qm ak kətoṯo, kəmdagəl aʕlox."
data.translation: "Setze dich nur wieder zu den Hühnern", sagte sie, "er hat Lügen über dich ausgesagt."

rationale: New ʕal allegation-target subsense; compact standalone command and accusation.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (PrS 70/32)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Dugle kəmdaglət." Omər: "Bi ziyara lə kəmdaganno." Omər: "B ayna ziyara?" Omər: "Di ḥalbube."
data.translation: "Du lügst", antwortete das Pferd. "Ich schwöre beim Wallfahrtsort, ich lüge nicht." "Bei welchem Wallfahrtsort?" fragte das Pferd. "Bei dem von Chalbube!"

rationale: One selected context brings Infectum sense 1 from four to five and jointly documents cognate dugle and contracted negative first person.

summary: example for sense 1c in Infectum (PrS 84/76)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Qṭal u greʕo afandim, dugle kəmdagəl aʕli, lašan d qəṭlatli."
data.translation: Darauf sagte der Kater: "Töte den Diener, Herr, er hat mich verleumdet, damit du mich töten möchtest."

rationale: Second clear example of ʕal defamatory target; purpose clause rules out a mere addressee reading.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part act. (57/140)

data.turoyo: Qayəm, azze komər u ḥa yawmo, mḥele ʕal u tarʕo du bayto du zlam mdaglonano "taq taq", omər nafiqo i barṯo du mdaglono, kətle barṯo, komər xd u kukwo.
data.translation: Er machte sich eines Tages auf, ging und klopfte an das Haustor des Lügenbeutels "tack tack!" Da kam die Tochter des Lügners heraus. Er hatte nämlich eine Tochter, schön wie ein Stern.

rationale: Thin Part act. cell; attributive and substantivized mdaglono in one narrative context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (59/66)

data.turoyo: Lu zʕuro mlaʕele bu ʕammayḏe, məlle: "Kobaʕno, d l obat i nuxratayḏi l ḥreno. I mdagaltayḏi yo.
data.translation: Der Junge bat seinen Oheim inständigst und sprach: "Du sollst meine Braut keinem anderen geben, sie ist mir versprochen!

rationale: Thin Detransitive cell; possessive mdagaltayḏi and explicit bride context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part act. (74/134)

data.turoyo: W haka lawyo lawəšto aǧ ǧule di kaluṯo, xa ono mdaglono no.”
data.translation: Und wenn sie die Brautkleider nicht anhat, so bin ich ein Lügner.

rationale: Thin Part act. cell; explicit predicative liar construction.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (95/91)

data.turoyo: Ono ste Teli ʕAyšano, i=barṯo d Osman Pašano, i=barṯo d ʕammux no, mdagle d ḥḏoḏe na, lazəm šəqlina ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Ich bin Teli Aischane, die Tochter des Osman Pascha, deines Oheims! Wie sind einander versprochen, wir müssen einander heiraten.

rationale: Fills Detransitive Part. Pass. to five; plural state with reciprocal d- and first-person copula.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (96/196)

data.turoyo: Laybi d mdaganna aʕle.
data.translation: Ich kann sie ihm nicht verloben.

rationale: Thin Infectum sense 2 and newly attested ʕal partner government.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (107/32)

data.turoyo: Adyawma ono, d kətno, i nxiraytayḏux, heš aḥna b gawa d emayna, l babonayna mdagallallan ʕal ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Ich, die ich deine Verlobte bin, als wir noch im Mutterleihe waren, haben unsere Väter uns einander versprochen.

rationale: Fills Preterit sense 2 to five and demonstrates ʕal reciprocal government with explicit fathers.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (Jan 2.18/3744)

data.turoyo: Mdagele u xabro du ḥasyo. <...>
data.translation: He contradicted the bishop's statement. <...>

rationale: First post-R1 Preterit example for II.1b, with an explicit nominal statement object.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (Jan 2.18/3749)

data.turoyo: ʕAs əno, kubaʕ d mdagalno u xabrayḏox! Qay lə kuḏaʕnox, hawxayo, bas i maǧburiye i iḏo d lə kmənkoto kmənšoqo!"
data.translation: 'As for me, do I want to contradict your statement? Why, do I not know you? That is how it is, but compulsion, the hand that cannot be bitten is kissed!'

rationale: First post-R1 Infectum example for II.1b; explicit xabrayḏox distinguishes content denial from lying to the listener.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 3.49/1339)

data.turoyo: B́aṯ-qiyomo Maḥbe: Haymən ono d mdaglallox, i naqqa du zad, əzzawalle hanək šxwa li Bəšeriye, məbliwa gawde, mṭənwa zad. Mṭənwa tətən, zad.
data.translation: Widow Mahbe: Believe me, if I tell you a lie, at the time of the provisions, those people used to go, say, to Bisheriye; they used to take skins and bring provisions. They used to bring tobacco, provisions.

rationale: Unusual incorporated l-type addressee and overt feminine first-person subject ono; adds valency evidence despite the full ordinary cell. Preserve positive wording and the uncertain clause relation.

summary: Sense 2: revise the gloss
after: versprechen (ʕam); auch (mit ʕal), besonders beim gegenseitigen Eheversprechen
rationale: 107/8 and 107/32 explicitly use ʕal ḥḏoḏe for the same betrothal relation; 96/196 has aʕle. This adds attested government without creating a second promise meaning.

summary: New idiom: dugle mdagele/mdagəl 'Lügen erzählen'

data.turoyo: Omər: "Dugle kəmdaglət", - u paša məlle lu qahwači.
data.translation: Da sagte der Statthalter zum Kaffewirt: »Du lügst«.

rationale: Recurring cognate-noun collocation, not a light-verb sense. Glossary search for dugle found no matching listed collocation.

summary: Lying and promising remain distinct despite marriage contexts. The active promise partner is introduced by ʕam or ʕal; direct/pronominal themes and a giving clause also occur.

Detransitive Part. Pass. expresses betrothal status: feminine mdagalto, plural mdagle, possessive/relational d- and reciprocal d ḥḏoḏe; 107/53 also has ʕal ḥḏoḏe. These are states with copulas, not new event senses.
Part act. mdaglono 'liar' follows the inherited classification. JTM 2.5/3 mdaglono after laybi is less securely separable from the nominal form, so it is not added as an Infectum example.
Contracted first-person kəmdaganno occurs across PrS and Ritter. Irrealis and negative Infectum, and ḥašša ... d mdagli disclaimers, do not create senses.
PrS 73/29 matches the example cited prs 210/29; Talay 1/309 matches LB 309. Edition/page aliases are not silently corrected. 95/40 and 107/16 are already cited in the Detransitive example.

Jan Beṯ-Şawoce round 2. All supplied English is project machine translation, not an edition translation; analyses and sense decisions rest on the Turoyo. Quoted English is copied verbatim and labelled as machine translation. Round-1 proposals are the baseline and are not repeated in this JSON.
All Jan tokens concern lying or denial, not betrothal. No new evidence overturns R1's promise and Detransitive betrothal distinctions.

R1 already fills the ordinary II.1 Infectum cell to five and Preterit to five; a plural accusation alone (Jan 1.42/1851) does not justify a duplicate thin-cell addition. dugle plus the verb supports R1's existing collocation and is not proposed again.

Hypothetical claims of firsthand knowledge at Jan 1.36/1525 and 1.45/1951 concern possible lying, not asserted deceit. mdagalno aʕlayxu / aʕlox at Jan 2.4/497,894 addresses the deceived hearer, rather than the target of R1's defamatory II.1c.

Maḥbe's d mdaglono at Jan 3.49/1336 is provisionally finite Infectum, parallel to Jan 3.55/1589 and her explicit ono d mdaglallox. The male-shaped liar noun interpretation is not established by the machine translation. No negation is inserted into her positive verb phrase.

The statement object u xabro du ḥasyo / u xabrayḏox is denied or contradicted, unlike a person who is lied to. This is already R1 II.1b. The Jan two-token sequence fills form cells that R1's Imperativ example leaves empty.
Does mdageli in the PrS retractions mean an unintended mistake, an admission of lying, or simply withdrawal of the claim?
Confirm the form and category of JTM 2.5/3 mdaglono after laybi, as against agent noun mdaglono.
In MAC NE Interview 2/243, does mdagele əšti+alfo aʕman assert a promise or describe fraudulent dealing? The frame supports sense 2, but the edition says 'swindled'; no example added.
105/71 has a partial alignment flag: the German includes a removal event absent from this verse. Its translation has not been quoted; verify the edition alignment.
Confirm PrS 60/125 singular kəmdagəl with translated plural accusers, and the contracted argument suffixes in 59/67.
Compact records lack verse text in this input and could not be independently checked.
Confirm finite feminine first-person mdaglono versus a predicate Part act. at Jan 3.49/1336 and 3.55/1589.
What is the full unfused form of mdaglallox, and does d introduce a rhetorical assurance, condition or consequence? Source has no negation in those clauses.
Resolve W aḥna kəmdagəl at Jan 1.53/2554: broken discourse and singular verb prevent a secure speaker/number analysis.

Admissions mdageli retract an assertion (PrS 18/27; 23/23; 80/9; MAC NE Mem and Zin/35); whether unintentional error is lexicalized remains unproved. Retain under false speaking, without asserting a new 'be mistaken' sense.

Jan extends independent support for R1's statement-denial subsense to another person's xabro, with a direct nominal object in both Preterit and Infectum. The existing broad gloss covers this; no repeated sense proposal.
mdaglallox has an incorporated l-type addressee beside the inherited ʕal- target. The lying meaning remains unchanged; contractions require person/recipient confirmation.
